title: General Assistant
description: A flexible, no-frills assistant for whatever you throw at it.

title: Workspace Assistant
description: Answers questions about your own workspace - which agents you've added and what agent groups you've set up - by checking your library directly instead of guessing.

title: Brainstorm Partner
description: Riffs on your ideas and pushes them further with follow-up questions.

title: Decision Helper
description: Helps you weigh a decision by laying out tradeoffs and asking clarifying questions.

title: Explain It Simply
description: Explains any topic you throw at it in plain, jargon-free language.

title: Devil's Advocate
description: Pushes back on your argument to help you pressure-test it before you commit.

title: Daily Briefing Bot
description: Looks up a topic you care about and gives you a quick daily-style briefing.

title: Quick Math Helper
description: Handles quick calculations and unit conversions on the fly.

title: Second Opinion Bot
description: Reviews a plan or piece of work and gives you an honest second opinion.
